documentationPages.title: Animated Gradient With SVG
documentationPages.description: An animated multi-color gradient background effect with SVG elements.

documentationPages.title: Pixel Trail
documentationPages.description: A pixelated trail effect that recolors grid pixels as you move your cursor.

documentationPages.title: Circling Elements
documentationPages.description: A component that creates a circling effect on its children.

documentationPages.title: 3D CSS Box
documentationPages.description: A simple 3D box component with "CSS-only" 3D transforms.

documentationPages.title: Drag Elements
documentationPages.description: Drag any html element — image, div, video — around freely in a container.

documentationPages.title: Float
documentationPages.description: A component that creates a gentle floating effect on its child.

documentationPages.title: Marquee Along SVG Path
documentationPages.description: A component that scrolls html elements along an SVG path.

documentationPages.title: Media Between Text
documentationPages.description: A component that animates a media (image or video) between two text elements.

documentationPages.title: Screensaver
documentationPages.description: A component that animates its child with the infamous screensaver effect.

documentationPages.title: Simple Marquee
documentationPages.description: A simple marquee component for scrolling HTML elements.

documentationPages.title: Stacking Cards
documentationPages.description: A component used in websites to display layered cards that stack on top of one another, often with interactive animations.

documentationPages.title: Sticky Footer
documentationPages.description: A demo showcasing a footer that sticks to the bottom of the page.

documentationPages.title: Box Carousel
documentationPages.description: A 3D carousel component that displays items in a rotating box/cube layout with drag support and smooth animations.

documentationPages.title: Gooey SVG Filter
documentationPages.description: An svg filter component that creates a gooey effect on the background. Can be used to create fluid interfaces or rounded-at-all-corners panels. Limited support for Safari.

documentationPages.title: Pixelate SVG Filter
documentationPages.description: A filter component that applies a pixelation effect with an SVG filter. Safari is not supported.

documentationPages.title: Image Trail
documentationPages.description: A component that creates a trail effect on cursor/touch movement. Works also with videos, svgs, or any type of html elements.

documentationPages.title: Parallax Floating
documentationPages.description: A component that creates a parallax floating effect on cursor/touch movement. Works also with videos, svgs, or any type of html elements.

documentationPages.title: Cursor Attractor & Gravity
documentationPages.description: A set of wrapper components for creating physics-based attractors and gravity animations with Matter.js.

documentationPages.title: Elastic Line
documentationPages.description: A wobbly svg line with a spring cursor interaction.

documentationPages.title: Gravity
documentationPages.description: A set of wrapper components for creating physics-based gravity animations with Matter.js.

documentationPages.title: Basic Number Ticker
documentationPages.description: A component that animates a number from one value to another.

documentationPages.title: Breathing Text
documentationPages.description: A text component that animates the font variation settings of letters in a breathing effect continuously. Works only with variable fonts.

documentationPages.title: Letter 3D Swap
documentationPages.description: A text component that swap the letters in a text with a box 3D effect.

documentationPages.title: Letter Swap
documentationPages.description: A text component that swaps the letters vertically on hover.

documentationPages.title: Random Letter Swap
documentationPages.description: A text component that randomly swaps the letters vertically on hover.

documentationPages.title: Scramble Hover
documentationPages.description: A text component that scrambles the text on hover.

documentationPages.title: Scramble In
documentationPages.description: A text component that reveals the text with a scrambled part in front.

documentationPages.title: Scroll and Swap Text
documentationPages.description: A text component that swaps the letters vertically on scroll.

documentationPages.title: Text Along Path
documentationPages.description: A text component that animates along an SVG path.

documentationPages.title: Text Cursor Proximity
documentationPages.description: A text component that animates the letters based on the cursor proximity

documentationPages.title: Text Highlighter
documentationPages.description: An animated text highlighting component with multiple trigger modes and directional animations.

documentationPages.title: Text Rotate
documentationPages.description: A text component that switches the rendered text from a list.

documentationPages.title: Typewriter
documentationPages.description: A component that types out a text, one letter at a time.

documentationPages.title: Underline Animation
documentationPages.description: A component that animates a text underline.

documentationPages.title: Underline To Background
documentationPages.description: A text component that animates a text underline into a text background.

documentationPages.title: Variable Font And Cursor
documentationPages.description: A text component that animates the font variation settings based on the cursor position. Works only with variable fonts.

documentationPages.title: Variable Font Cursor Proximity
documentationPages.description: A text component that animates the font variation settings of letters based on the cursor proximity. Works only with variable fonts.

documentationPages.title: Variable Font Hover By Letter
documentationPages.description: A text component that animates the font variation settings of letters. Works only with variable fonts.

documentationPages.title: Variable Font Hover By Random Letter
documentationPages.description: A text component that animates the font variation settings of letters in a random order. Works only with variable fonts.

documentationPages.title: Vertical Cut Reveal
documentationPages.description: A text component that reveals the text with a cut reveal effect.
